description:
After repeated failures, Ba-Ram was about to give up her dream of becoming a singer when she accidentally got involved in her cousin Han Seok's failing hologram business and became a tester for the hologram mask ‘Echo’. Ba-Ram became the fictional character ‘Min So-Won’ and challenged herself to be a singer once more. Unlike her past failures, she instantly became famous. Ba-Ram must conceal Min So-Won's true identity until the test concludes. However, her friend ‘Gu Re-Um’, who had subscribed to Ba-Ram's YouTube channel for a long time, was actually Kang Ri-Wun, a member of the idol group Sprinter. Meanwhile, Seo Yi-Hyeon, a genius producer and her classmate, suddenly starts showing increasing interest in both Ba-Ram and Min So-Won...! 

Can Ba-Ram keep her secret and achieve her goal unscathed?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
